Subject: DPA, SCCs evidence and SOC2 for procurement

Hi Soojin,

We're getting close on the commercial terms and procurement asked me to pull together the security & privacy package so their legal and security teams can sign off. Two asks from our side to move this to procurement: 

1) DPA: can you share Redwood's standard DPA and confirm whether you're ok with the following minimal changes (we prefer not to change the SCA/SCC language): retention carveouts for backups, subprocessor list cadence to be quarterly, and a 30-day notice for policy changes.

2) SCCs / Evidence: our security team requested a completed SCCs matrix (or CAIQ/SIG answers) and the latest SOC2 Type II report (redacted is fine). They also requested a short list of evidence items (log retention, encryption in transit/at rest, key rotation cadence, SOC attestation date).

Timeline: procurement would like the materials by EOD Wednesday (2026-09-02) to hit their internal review next week. Is that feasible? If not, please propose a path/owners.

Thanks,
Alex Dunn
Director of Procurement, FinSecure
alex.dunn@finsecure.com

--

Alex / Ben / Soojin — thanks for the context and the materials. Summary of our plan and asks from Legal/Security: 

1) DPA redlines: I reviewed the proposed DPA redlines you sent. We're comfortable with limited edits to retention carveouts and the quarterly subprocessor cadence; however, we cannot accept a full removal of the SCC clauses (we rely on standard EU SCCs language). I've attached a tracked DPA (Redwood_DPA_Proposed_Redlines.docx) with comments. Key asks from FinSecure we need clarity on: whether the 30-day policy-change notice is a hard requirement (we generally provide 30 days for material changes) and whether FinSecure requires a specific data locality clause.

2) SCCs / CAIQ / SIG: We maintain a completed CAIQ and a SIG Lite summary. Karthik will curate a concise SCCs evidence bundle:
   - SOC2 Type II (redacted) 
   - CAIQ export (sensitive fields redacted)
   - SCC mapping sheet (how our controls map to SCC clauses)
   - Short answers on encryption, KMS/HSM usage, key rotation, retention policy, and subprocessor list cadence.

3) Timeline: Karthik and I will finalize the evidence bundle and the redline summary by EOD Monday 2026-08-31. Once you confirm DPA acceptance or point out any non-starters, we can prepare a DocuSign envelope. Ben — please hold on sending the envelope until Legal confirms.

4) Signature routing: when ready, we'll send a DocuSign with the DPA + signature page only. We prefer the FinSecure authorized signer to execute; if procurement requires countersignature by a specific role, please flag now. After signature we will upload the fully executed DPA to the HubSpot deal (FD-2026-089) and share a link to the evidence bundle.

Action items:
- Alex / FinSecure: confirm whether the 30-day policy-change notice is acceptable and confirm the authorized signer name/email for DocuSign.
- Ben: create HubSpot record FD-2026-089 and mark as "pending signature".
- Karthik: assemble evidence bundle and SOC2 redaction notes.

I'll attach the redline doc and SOC2 redacted stub for now. If anything blocks on confidentiality or regulatory (HIPAA concerns), call me directly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
